children: Caleres Inc reported results for the 2026 quarter with consolidated net sales of $695.45M and diluted EPS of $1.71, versus $658.52M and $0.2 in the prior-year quarter, driven by strength in the Brand Portfolio and tariff recoveries that supported margins.
¹ Reported as “Net sales”. ² Reported as “Net earnings”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings per common share attributable to Caleres, Inc. shareholders”.
Revenue growth of 5.6% was driven by the Brand Portfolio, which rose 23.6%, while Famous Footwear declined 6.3%.
Direct-to-consumer channels remained dominant, representing roughly 71% of sales; Brand Portfolio DTC was about 37% and Famous Footwear e-commerce about 14%.
The August 2025 acquisition of Stuart Weitzman materially boosted Brand Portfolio sales and margin contribution.
Operational pressure at Famous Footwear included weaker traffic and comparable sales down about 5.9%, while Brand Portfolio saw strong wholesale and international growth.
Tariff refunds of $55.6M, along with sourcing and pricing actions, helped improve gross margins and inventory cost management.
